flawed_step: Line 0078 incorrectly claims that pairing the ith bipartite graphs on X and Y produces 2^{k-1} bipartite graphs. It produces k-1 graphs.
counterexample: Take k=3 and n=8, partitioned into |X|=|Y|=4. Each K_4 is covered by k-1=2 bipartite graphs. Pairing the first covers on X and Y gives one bipartite graph, and pairing the second gives another: exactly 2 graphs, not 2^{3-1}=4.
assessment_summary: The stated graph count in the converse construction is false. The construction works only with the corrected count k-1, after which the X-Y biclique is the kth graph.
